notes:
Passed on the fake backend by `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/qlan3__gym-games --backend fake` (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware run and no human review is claimed. This package configures the NChain-v1 member of the card's entry symbols. The fake backend is the package's own pure Python NChainEnv re-implementation (fake.py): the gate has no gymnasium, numpy or upstream package, and package code never imports the clone. It implements reset/step/reward/close and the duck-typed Discrete/Box spaces, returns the full observation vector of the default chain length (no array is truncated), and was not compared with an upstream run. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('NChain-v1')) was not run: it needs the upstream package installed, and upstream registers the id when gym_exploration is imported (test.py:4), so a sim deployment must import gym_exploration before gymnasium.make. The fake returns lists of Python ints where upstream returns numpy uint8 arrays, and the bridge auto-resets a fresh episode after a terminal step (autoreset = True) while the upstream class does not auto-reset; both are in the fidelity gaps, as is the absence of dynamics (F0). Warnings are the expected Gymnasium family warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the bridge's pending seed) and four G8.NO_UNIT for integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index, seed twice); they do not fail the gate, and no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning remains. The other card entry symbols (DiabolicalCombLockEnv, OneDiabolicalCombinationLock, LockBernoulliEnv, LockGaussianEnv) are not covered by this package: it configures one family member, as the exemplar does. Only catalogue classes are used; there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
